battle.theater: 蘇丹南部赤道省與上尼羅河省
battle.brief: 1955年8月18日，赤道軍團第二連在托里特起兵，蘇丹南北對抗延續近十七年。卡面這具1860年的加特林機槍早已退出一線，真正開火的是維克斯.303中型機槍與迫擊砲；但它留下的是英軍1880年代蘇丹戰役的火力線傳統，南部營連至今仍自覺承襲。

kit.history: 六根管子用人力轉動。它的後坐力分散在六次上，所以能壓住一個師。

countries: 交戰雙方是蘇丹南部武裝與以喀土穆為中心的政府軍。1955至1956年間，名義上的英埃蘇丹由英國與埃及共管，蘇丹國防軍轄下分赤道軍團、上尼羅河團與巴赫爾加扎爾團，軍官多為北方人，士兵則以南方人佔多數；南方三個省只以駐防軍與警察維持秩序。1956年獨立後，蘇丹共和國政府軍接管防務；1958年易卜拉欣·阿布德中將政變後由軍人執政，1964年十月革命推翻軍政府，1969年加法爾·尼邁里上校再以政變上台，改稱蘇丹民主共和國。反方自1955年托里特起義延續而來，1963年8月在坎帕拉集結為安亞尼亞游擊軍，另分裂出阿扎尼亞解放陣線等武裝；1975年出現第二支安亞尼亞，1983年部分人馬併入蘇丹人民解放軍。外援方面，烏干達在1965至1969年間允許聯合行動在其境內進行，利比亞自1969年介入、1970年更投入戰鬥，以色列則自1969年起在武器、情報與顧問上支援安亞尼亞；政府軍一側得到埃及與蘇聯的後勤與外交支持。
countriesEn: The two sides were the southern Sudanese armed groups and the government army centred on Khartoum. Between 1955 and 1956 Anglo-Egyptian Sudan was under a British-Egyptian condominium, and the Sudan Defence Force (SDF) was organised around the Equatoria Corps, the Upper Nile and Bahr al Ghazal; officers were overwhelmingly northern while the rank and file was mostly southern, and the three southern provinces were held down by small garrisons and police. After independence in 1956 the army of the Republic of Sudan took over the security task; after the 1958 coup of Brigadier Ibrahim Abboud the army ruled directly, the October Revolution of 1964 threw out the military government, and the coup of Colonel Gaafar Nimeiry in 1969 created the Democratic Republic of Sudan. The opposing side grew out of the Torit mutiny of 1955, gathered at Kampala in August 1963 as the Anyanya guerrilla army, and later split off into formations such as the Azania Liberation Front; a second Anyanya appeared in 1975, and in 1983 some of its people folded into the Sudan People's Liberation Movement. Foreign support went both ways: Uganda allowed joint operations on its own territory between 1965 and 1969, Libya entered from 1969 and was in combat by 1970, and Israel backed the Anyanya from 1969 with weapons, intelligence and advisers, while the government side drew logistics and diplomatic backing from Egypt and the Soviet Union.
people: 關鍵人物分屬兩條線。南方方面，赤道軍團出身的約瑟夫·拉古是最重要的軍事人物，他參與1963年在坎帕拉約瑟夫·奧杜霍住所召開的建軍會議，1964年11月喀土穆與阿特巴拉兵變中倒戈，1971年又在以色列協助下推翻穆爾塔特·梅恩，把各支部隊統一到南蘇丹解放運動旗下，1972年代表南方簽署阿迪斯阿貝巴協定；梅恩於1969年被一致選為南方運動領袖，前領袖阿格里·雅登因內部矛盾在同年出走；奧杜霍、喬治·阿昆貝克、尤利烏斯·莫羅加與塞韋里諾·富利是建軍元老。北方方面，伊斯梅爾·阿扎里出任首任總理，1958年奪權的阿布德於1964年十月革命中下台，尼邁里則是1969年後主導對南部作戰並在1972年簽署協議的人物。外國方面，以色列軍事顧問大衛·貝恩-烏齊耶爾自1969年參與策劃，以色列情報單位接手軍火線；德籍顧問羅爾夫·施泰納1971年在坎帕拉被捕後被引渡回喀土穆受審，最初判死刑、改判三年監禁，在西德施壓下提前獲釋。
peopleEn: The decisive figures fall into two lines. In the south: Joseph Lagu, an Equatoria Corps officer, was the central military personality, attending the founding meeting at Joseph Oduho's house in Kampala in 1963, defecting in the Khartoum and Atbara mutinies of November 1964, and in 1971, with Israeli help, deposing Gordon Muortat Mayen and bringing the separate formations together under the South Sudan Liberation Movement; he signed the Addis Ababa Agreement for the south in 1972. Mayen had been elected leader of the southern movement in 1969, and the previous leader Aggrey Jaden walked out the same year over internal feuds; Oduho, George Akumbek, Julius Moroga and Severino Fuli were the other founders. In the north: Ismail al-Azhari was the first prime minister, Abboud took power in 1958 and fell in the October Revolution of 1964, and Nimeiry was the man who directed the war against the south from 1969 and signed the agreement in 1972. From abroad: the Israeli military adviser David Ben-Uziel was involved in the planning from 1969 and Israeli intelligence ran the arms pipeline; the German adviser Rolf Steiner was arrested at Kampala in 1971 and handed over to Khartoum, was sentenced to death and then to three years' imprisonment, and was released early after pressure from West Germany.
kits: 卡面的加特林機槍生於1860年，六管人力手搖，後坐力分散在六次發射之間。同一片蘇丹河谷曾經真正用過它：加特林條目所列的戰役名單包括1880年代的馬赫迪戰爭同1896至1898年英埃戰爭，即英軍重新奪回蘇丹那一役——但到1955年，距離它發明已近一個世紀，英軍標準武器早已換成彈鏈供彈的機槍世代。1955年掌防務的英埃蘇丹國防軍由英軍指揮，轄下四個軍團為駱駝軍團、東方阿拉伯軍團、西方阿拉伯軍團同赤道軍團；赤道軍團即南方軍團，駐南部三個省。各軍團配屬砲兵、工程、裝甲車、機槍連，另有醫療、通信同運輸單位；二戰期間蘇丹國防軍曾以機槍連、榴彈砲連同臨時拼裝的裝甲車投入東非戰役。1955年8月18日赤道軍團第二連在托里特起兵時，起義方手上主要是北方營地繳獲的舊式英軍輕武器；1963年後安亞尼亞另經以色列以及中非、烏干達渠道取得現代步槍、輕機槍、迫擊砲、便攜式無線電台，配卡車、摩托車與四驅車作機動。雙方都無成建制裝甲同重炮，政府的火力優勢靠公路沿線固定火力點，游擊隊以輕武器同分散攜帶應對。
kitsEn: The Gatling gun on the card was born in 1860, six barrels turned by hand, its recoil spread across six shots. The same Sudanese river valley really did see it in action: the wars listed for the Gatling include the Mahdist War of the 1880s and the Anglo-Egyptian War of 1896 to 1898, the campaign in which the British retook the Sudan. By 1955, however, nearly a century had passed since its invention, and the British standard weapon had long since moved on to the belt-fed machine gun generation. The Anglo-Egyptian Sudan Defence Force that held the security portfolio in 1955 was under British command, and was organised in four corps: the Camel Corps, the Eastern Arab Corps, the Western Arab Corps and the Equatoria Corps; the Equatoria Corps, often called the Southern Corps, garrisoned the three southern provinces. Each corps was supported by artillery, engineers, armoured cars and machine gun units, alongside medical, signals and transport services, and during the Second World War the force committed machine gun companies, howitzer batteries and improvised armoured cars to the East African campaigns. When No. 2 Company of the Equatoria Corps rose at Torit on 18 August 1955, the insurgents held chiefly old British-pattern light weapons taken from northern barracks; after 1963 the Anyanya separately obtained modern rifles, light machine guns, mortars and portable radio sets through Israeli and central-African and Ugandan channels, and moved on lorries, motorcycles and four-wheel-drive vehicles. Neither side had formed armour or heavy artillery in any quantity: the government's fire advantage rested on fixed gun positions along the roads, and the guerrillas answered with light weapons and dispersed carrying.
tactics: 安亞尼亞的基本戰術是游擊而非會戰：小分隊脫離村莊後分散潛行，晝伏夜襲，襲擊政府軍哨所、巡邏隊與補給縱隊，打完即散，難以一次殲滅。1955至1963年間這些行動接近無組織的武裝逃散，武器彈藥多自北方軍營繳獲而來；1963年9月19日發動第一次有組織進攻後，才出現明確的攻勢目標：沿托里特至朱巴鐵路兩側與鄉村縱深推進，奪取驛站與渡口，一度把政府軍擠回尼羅河沿岸，切斷南北陸路聯繫。政府軍以縱隊掃蕩回應：步兵營沿公路推進，在關鍵路口設堡壘式據點，以輕機槍與迫擊砲封鎖縱深，通信靠無線電台與空中偵察判斷游擊隊位置，再派摩托化突擊組隊清剿。雨季自六月至十月，道路泥濘、車載機動受限，政府縱隊的推進節奏被打斷，公路與鐵路同時成為游擊隊埋雷與伏擊的高風險路段；政府因此被迫以鐵路與河流航運維持補給，戰線拉成沿線僵持。1969年後外部情報與武器到位，游擊隊編制更趨連隊化，並在1970年前後一度企圖切斷朱巴方向的公路與襲擊南部主要營區，令政府必須把精兵調回城市與鐵路沿線。
tacticsEn: The Anyanya's basic method was guerrilla war rather than set-piece battle: small bands left their villages and dispersed, lay up by day and struck at night against government posts, patrols and supply columns, then scattered, so that no single engagement could destroy them. Between 1955 and 1963 these actions were close to armed drift, with weapons and ammunition taken from northern barracks; the first organised offensive on 19 September 1963 gave them targets and formations, pushing along both sides of the Torit-Juba railway and into the rural depth, seizing stations and river crossings and squeezing the government back towards the Nile. The government answered with columns: infantry battalions advanced along the roads, threw up blockhouse posts at the junctions, covered the depth with light machine guns and mortars, and used radio sets together with aerial reconnaissance to locate concentrations, sending motorised striking groups after them. In the rains, from June to October, mud slowed the motorised columns and broke their rhythm, while the road and the railway became the most dangerous stretches for mines and ambush; the government was therefore driven to supply itself by rail and by river, and the front set became a strung-out stalemate along those lines. After 1969, with outside intelligence and weapons, the guerrilla bands grew into company-sized formations and pushed operations against the main government garrisons in the south, which forced the government to pull trained troops back towards the towns and the railway.
data: 可查的數字有限，但足以說明量級。1955年蘇丹國防軍總兵力約六千至七千人，其中四個步兵旅之一常駐赤道省，負責南部三個省；政府軍到1971年底增至約三萬六千人。安亞尼亞方面，早期可核對的武裝人數為六千至一萬二千，1960年代末估計約一萬八千人，1971年拉古整合各部後規模再升。全戰爭自1955年8月18日托里特起義，至1972年3月27日阿迪斯阿貝巴協定，歷時約十六年七個月。戰傷方面，學界引用的一項研究估計交戰雙方的作戰人員陣亡逾十萬，另有大量裝備隨政府軍逐次收復城鎮而落入游擊隊手中。南方三個省的面積約佔今日南蘇丹國土大部分，平原、沼澤與叢林地形使小分隊游擊得以長期維持。
dataEn: Few firm figures survive, but enough to show the scale. In 1955 the Sudan Defence Force numbered about 6,000 to 7,000 men in all, one of its four infantry brigades stationed in Equatoria Province and responsible for the three southern provinces; by late 1971 the government army had grown to roughly 36,000. On the Anyanya side the verifiable strength was 6,000 to 12,000 armed men in the early years, rising to an estimated 18,000 by the late 1960s and higher again after Lagu consolidated the various bands in 1971. The war ran from the mutiny at Torit on 18 August 1955 to the Addis Ababa Agreement of 27 March 1972, about sixteen years and seven months. For losses, one study cited in the literature puts the dead among the fighting forces of both sides at more than 100,000, and large quantities of equipment changed hands each time the government retook a town. The three southern provinces cover most of the area of present-day South Sudan, and the plains, swamps and woodland are what allowed a dispersed guerrilla war to be sustained for so long.
cause: 起因是多層的。英埃共管時期，南北雖同屬蘇丹，卻按兩套不同的殖民治理邏輯運作；1950年代北方政治壓力促成南北合併為單一行政區，南方並未事先協商。1956年獨立後，北方阿拉伯穆斯林精英主導國家權力，南方人（多為基督徒與傳統信仰者）在議會、公職與資源分配上被系統性邊緣化；南方人在政府軍中的士兵比例雖高，指揮層卻幾乎清一色北方人，這種落差同時製造了南方軍人的隸屬感與北方政客的安全焦慮。1955年8月18日的直接導火線是兩件事：一名南方國會議員在喀土穆受審，以及一份聲稱要求北方軍官鎮壓南方人的電報被指為偽造。赤道軍團第二連在托里特隨即起兵，數日內擴散到朱巴、耶伊、馬里迪。此後政權更替未改善結構：1958年阿布德政變、1964年十月革命、1969年尼邁里政變之後，北方始終拒絕把南方的自治訴求寫成制度安排，談判屢次因軍方否決而告吹；1965年南方臨時政府與安亞尼亞的合作嘗試、以及1971年拉古以武力整合各部，都未能在北方體制內換取實質自治，衝突因此長期化為常態戰爭。
causeEn: The causes were layered. During the condominium the north and the south were both part of Sudan yet administered under two different colonial logics; political pressure from the north in the 1950s merged them into a single administrative region without prior consultation with the south. After independence in 1956, northern Arab-Muslim elites took control of the state, while southerners, mostly Christian or followers of local religions, were systematically marginalised in parliament, in public office and in the distribution of resources; southerners were a large share of the army's soldiers but the command layer was almost entirely northern, and that gap bred both a sense of grievance in the southern ranks and a security anxiety in northern politicians. Two immediate triggers set off the mutiny of 18 August 1955: the trial in Khartoum of a southern member of the national assembly, and a telegram supposedly ordering northern administrators to repress southerners, which was alleged to be false. No. 2 Company of the Equatoria Corps rose at Torit, and within days the revolt had spread to Juba, Yei and Maridi. Changes of government afterwards did not repair the structure: after the coups of 1958 and 1969 and the October Revolution of 1964, the north never accepted the southern demand for autonomy as a permanent institutional arrangement, and negotiations collapsed each time the army vetoed them; the 1965 attempt to combine a southern provisional government with the Anyanya, and Lagu's 1971 unification of the guerrillas by force, both failed to buy real autonomy from the northern system, and the conflict settled into a permanent war.
impact: 影響至少有四層。第一，南北的制度落差第一次被寫成有國際效力的文件：1972年協定設立南部自治區與區議會、區執行委員會，南方第一次獲得有憲制形式的自治權，但協議並未觸及自治的最終形態與主權歸屬，只規定內部自決的方向。第二，冷戰的代理人結構被引入非洲內戰：以色列支援安亞尼亞，埃及與蘇聯站在政府軍一側，利比亞與1971年後的烏干達伊迪·阿明政權各有其算盤，外來武器與顧問成為延長戰事的重要原因。第三，戰爭把南部大量年輕人口武裝化，塑造了此後數十年的武裝政治生態：1975年的第二支安亞尼亞、1983年蘇丹人民解放軍的成立，都源於此時形成的武裝與網絡。第四，協議的不完整被北方以拖延、分化與重新集權回應；1983年再度開火時，交戰雙方的目標與兵力構成已與1955年截然不同，說明前十七年並未解決核心爭議，只是把它推遲。
impactEn: At least four consequences can be traced. First, the gap between north and south was written down in a document with international standing: the 1972 agreement created a southern autonomous region with its own regional assembly and executive council, so the south gained constitutional autonomy for the first time, but the agreement did not settle the final shape of that autonomy or the question of sovereignty, pointing only in the direction of internal self-determination. Second, the proxy structure of the Cold War was pulled into an African civil war: Israel backed the Anyanya while Egypt and the Soviet Union stood with the government, and Libya and Idi Amin's Uganda after 1971 played their own games, so foreign weapons and advisers became one reason the war dragged on. Third, the war armed large numbers of young southerners and shaped the armed politics of the decades that followed: the second Anyanya of 1975 and the founding of the Sudan People's Liberation Movement in 1983 both grew out of the networks formed in this period. Fourth, the incompleteness of the agreement was answered in the north with delay, division and renewed centralisation; when the shooting resumed in 1983 the aims and the composition of the two sides were wholly different from 1955, which shows that the first seventeen years had not settled the central dispute, only postponed it.
result: 結果是有限而明確的終戰：1972年3月27日在亞的斯亞貝巴簽署的協定終止主要戰鬥，蘇丹民主共和國承認南部自治區，拉古代表南蘇丹解放運動簽署並回朱巴主持南部區級行政，阿布德派系武裝在蘇丹南部以外的地區衝突也隨之降溫。協議簽署當時即有反對：安亞尼亞部分指揮官如艾曼紐爾·阿布爾與約翰·加朗拒絕接受，認為條款出賣了最終自決，叛軍內部因而出現分裂，這一裂痕在1975年後公開化。同時，協議未設立常設維和機制，北方也未放棄重新收編南部武裝的目標；1974年阿克博守軍兵變再度令運動一分為二，1983年全面衝突爆發，戰爭延續至2005年全面和平協議，其後2011年南蘇丹獨立。換言之，第一次蘇丹內戰在1972年結束了戰鬥，卻把爭議完整地移交給下一場戰爭。
resultEn: The outcome was a limited but definite end to the fighting: the agreement signed at Addis Ababa on 27 March 1972 ended the main hostilities, the Democratic Republic of Sudan recognised the southern autonomous region, and Lagu signed for the South Sudan Liberation Movement and returned to Juba to run the regional administration. There was dissent even at the signature: commanders within the movement such as Emmanuel Abuur and John Garang rejected the terms as selling out the final claim to self-determination, and the movement split in consequence, a fissure that became public after 1975. At the same time no standing peacekeeping mechanism was created, and the north never abandoned the aim of folding the southern armed groups back into the national army; a mutiny by the Anyanya garrison at Akobo in 1974 split the movement again, and full-scale conflict returned in 1983, running to the Comprehensive Peace Agreement of 2005 and, after that, the independence of South Sudan in 2011. The First Sudanese Civil War ended its fighting in 1972 and handed the whole dispute to the next war.
